kharagpur-2013.notes: The 2026 live CodeChef practice pages (KGP13A-J) name no contest; they were matched by title and statement to Problems A-J of the on-site problem set PDF in the archive (problemset/20160310-wayback, cover 'ACM-ICPC 2013 Asia Regional Contest, Kharagpur Site, IIT Kharagpur, December 15, 2013'). The catalogue has no problem letters for this contest: A Election Campaign, B Olympic Village, C Stairway Reduction, D Building Township, E One-Way Roads, F Ant Colony, G Message Coding, H Toy Exchange, I Sequence Alignment, J Nomad Camp. The 'Explanation' sections on CodeChef read as later additions (one says the explanation is not provided).
